title: Who I work with
intro: Innovation only works when the whole ecosystem shows up. This is the circle I spend my weeks in.

players.label: Startups
players.note: I scout them, coach them and get them in front of the right people. Mostly I say no, which is how the yes stays valuable.

players.label: Corporates
players.note: I help innovation teams turn a vague mandate into a program with a problem statement, a shortlist and a decision at the end.

players.label: Investors
players.note: Deal flow, co-investment and honest feedback loops between VCs and the corporates piloting the same startups.

players.label: Governments
players.note: Ecosystem assessments and program design for public agencies that want more companies, not more conferences.

players.label: Accelerators
players.note: Mentoring founders, running workshops and designing the parts of a program that actually move the companies.

players.label: Builders
players.note: The AI and vibe coding crowd. I build my own small tools and trade notes with people who ship on weekends.
